## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe your ideal implementation. Which phase(s) does this affect?

- [ ] Phase 0: Confidence Gate
- [ ] Phase 1: Architectural & Logic Analysis
- [ ] Phase 2: Debugging & Gap Assessment
- [ ] Phase 3: Production-Ready Refactoring
- [ ] Phase 4: Senior-Engineer Self Code Review
- [ ] Phase 5: Verification & Live Simulation
- [ ] Phase 6: Readiness Report
- [ ] Operating Rules
- [ ] New phase (describe)
- [ ] Documentation/Wiki
- [ ] Examples/Templates

## Alternative Solutions Considered
Other approaches you've thought about.

## Skill Design Principles Check
Does this align with the skill's principles?

- [ ] **Backward compatible** — Existing invocations keep working
- [ ] **Phase integrity** — Distinct purpose, doesn't merge phases
- [ ] **Evidence-driven** — Verifiable against real running systems
- [ ] **Surgical discipline** — Minimal, targeted change
- [ ] **No mock data** — Real debugging scenarios only

## Example Usage
How would someone use this feature? Show invocation or workflow.

## Additional Context
Screenshots, mockups, references to other skills/tools, etc.
